name: Shebna Shebnah
overview: Shebna, also called Shebnah, served as a key royal official under King Hezekiah, holding the position of scribe and treasurer over the king's household. The Scriptures depict him alongside Eliakim and Joah as trusted administrators who communicated with foreign envoys and conveyed critical messages to the king, demonstrating his integral role in the governance and spiritual affairs of Judah. These passages highlight Shebna's prominence in the royal court during a time of national crisis, revealing the Lord's direct engagement with those in positions of authority.
